/*BudgetSelectNew.selectDgrCompoLeafListClass*/ SELECT A.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , A.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AS TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , A.TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ AS TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD AS TE_MNG_MOK_CD , A.COMP_GROUND AS COMP_GROUND , A.SORT_SEQ AS SORT_SEQ , C.FIS_FG_CD AS FIS_FG_CD , NVL(D.FIS_FG_NM, '') AS FIS_FG_NM , B.OFFICE_CD AS OFFICE_CD , NVL(B.OFFICE_NM, '') AS OFFICE_NM , NVL(B.OFFICE_RANK, 0) AS OFFICE_RANK , A.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , NVL(B.DEPT_NM, '') AS DEPT_NM , NVL(B.DEPT_RANK, 0) AS DEPT_RANK , C.DBIZ_CD AS DBIZ_CD , NVL(C.DBIZ_NM, '') AS DBIZ_NM , NVL(C.DBIZ_RANK, 0) AS DBIZ_RANK , TRIM(NVL(B.DEPT_NM, '') || ' > ' || NVL(C.DBIZ_NM, '') || ' > ' || DECODE(A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, NULL, '', '00000', '', SUBSTR(A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, 4)) || CASE WHEN NVL(A.COMP_GROUND, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' > ' || A.COMP_GROUND END) AS PATH_NM , DECODE(A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, NULL, '', '00000', '', SUBSTR(A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, 4)) || CASE WHEN NVL(M.TE_MNG_MOK_NM, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' || M.TE_MNG_MOK_NM END AS TE_MNG_MOK_NM , CAST((NVL(A.DEMAND_BGT_AMT, 0) / DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS DEMAND_BGT_AMT , CAST((NVL(A.DEMAND_DIFF_AMT, 0) / DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS DEMAND_DIFF_AMT , CAST((NVL(A.BGT_AMT, 0) / DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS BGT_AMT , CAST((NVL(A.PRE_AMT, 0) / DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS PRE_AMT , CAST((NVL(A.DIFF_AMT, 0) / DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS DIFF_AMT , '' AS FRSCES , NVL(R.REPORT_MSTR, '') AS REPORT_MSTR , NVL(R.REPORT_CD, '') AS REPORT_CD , NVL(R.REPORT_DETL_CD, '') AS REPORT_DETL_CD , NVL(R.GOV_SUB, '') AS GOV_SUB , '' AS INDI_ATTR , '' AS ADVNC_PROC , '' AS REPORT_NAMES , '' AS SHEET_NAMES , NVL(R.SEL010_YN, 'N') AS SEL010_YN , NVL(R.SEL020_YN, 'N') AS SEL020_YN , 'N' AS SEL030_YN , NVL(R.SEL040_YN, 'N') AS SEL040_YN , NVL(R.SEL050_YN, 'N') AS SEL050_YN , NVL(R.SEL055_YN, 'N') AS SEL055_YN , NVL(R.SEL060_YN, 'N') AS SEL060_YN , NVL(R.SEL090_YN, 'N') AS SEL090_YN , NVL(R.SELETC_YN, 'N') AS SELETC_YN , NVL(R.CHECK_YN031, 'N') AS CHECK_YN031 , NVL(R.CHECK_YN032, 'N') AS CHECK_YN032 , NVL(R.CHECK_YN033, 'N') AS CHECK_YN033 , NVL(R.CHECK_YN034, 'N') AS CHECK_YN034 , NVL(R.CHECK_YN035, 'N') AS CHECK_YN035 , 'N' AS CHECK_YN_TF1 , 'N' AS SEL_SHEET_YN , 'N' AS SEL_YN FROM TB_DGRCOMPO A , TB_DGRDEPT B , TB_DGRBIZ C , TB_YEARFISFG D , TB_DGRTEMNGMOK M , (SELECT Z.FIS_YEAR , Z.BGT_DGR , Z.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD NOT IN ('030','070','0A0','0B0','0C0','0D0') AND NVL(TRIM(Z.REPORT_MSTR),'') != '' THEN Z.REPORT_MSTR ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS REPORT_MSTR , GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD NOT IN ('030','070','0A0','0B0','0C0','0D0') AND NVL(TRIM(Z.REPORT_CD),'') != '' THEN Z.REPORT_CD ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS REPORT_CD , GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD NOT IN ('030','070','0A0','0B0','0C0','0D0') AND NVL(TRIM(Z.REPORT_DETL_CD),'') != '' THEN Z.REPORT_DETL_CD ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS REPORT_DETL_CD , GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD != '030' AND NVL(TRIM(Z.GOV_SUB),'') != '' THEN Z.GOV_SUB ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS GOV_SUB , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '010' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL010_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '020' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL020_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '040' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL040_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '050' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL050_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '055' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL055_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '060' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL060_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '090' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL090_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD IN ('040','050','055','060','070','080','090') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS SELETC_YN , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '030' AND Z.REPORT_DETL_CD = '031' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS CHECK_YN031 , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '030' AND Z.REPORT_DETL_CD = '032' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS CHECK_YN032 , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '030' AND Z.REPORT_DETL_CD = '033' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS CHECK_YN033 , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '030' AND Z.REPORT_DETL_CD = '034' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS CHECK_YN034 , MAX(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD = '030' AND Z.REPORT_DETL_CD = '035' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS CHECK_YN035 FROM TB_REPORT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND Z.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# GROUP BY Z.FIS_YEAR, Z.BGT_DGR, Z.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID ) R WHERE A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND A.COMPO_LEVEL = '1' AND (A.CNG_TYPE IS NULL OR A.CNG_TYPE = 'CH02' OR (A.CNG_TYPE = 'CH01' AND A.GRP_LVL != '2')) AND B.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND B.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND B.DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD AND C.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND C.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND C.DBIZ_CD = A.DBIZ_CD AND D.FIS_YEAR = C.FIS_YEAR AND D.FIS_FG_CD = C.FIS_FG_CD AND M.FIS_YEAR (+) = A.FIS_YEAR AND M.BGT_DGR (+) = A.BGT_DGR AND M.TE_MNG_MOK_CD (+) = A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD AND R.FIS_YEAR (+) = A.FIS_YEAR AND R.BGT_DGR (+) = A.BGT_DGR AND R.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID (+) = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USERDEPT Z WHERE Z.USER_ID = #userId# AND Z.DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD AND Z.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1)
AND D.FIS_FG_MST_CD = #fisFgMstCd# AND D.FIS_FG_CD = #fisFgCd# AND B.OFFICE_CD = #officeCd# AND B.DEPT_RANK >= #deptRankFr# AND B.DEPT_RANK <= #deptRankTo# AND A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD >= #teMngMokCdFr# AND A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD <= #teMngMokCdTo#
AND CAST((A.DIFF_AMT/DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) >= #condAmtFr#
AND CAST((A.DIFF_AMT/DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) <= #condAmtTo#
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REPORT ZR WHERE ZR.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND ZR.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND ZR.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND ZR.REPORT_MSTR = #reportMstl#)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REPORT ZR WHERE ZR.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND ZR.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND ZR.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND ZR.REPORT_CD = #reportCd#)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REPORT ZR WHERE ZR.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND ZR.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND ZR.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND ZR.REPORT_DETL_CD = #reportDetlCd#)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REPORT ZR WHERE ZR.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND ZR.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND ZR.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND ZR.GOV_SUB = #govSub#)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_DGRCOMPOFRSC Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND Z.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND Z.ADJ_DEF_FRSC_AMT != 0 AND Z.FRSC_FG_CD >= #frscFgCdFr# AND Z.FRSC_FG_CD <= #frscFgCdTo# )
ORDER BY NVL(B.OFFICE_RANK, 0), NVL(B.DEPT_RANK, 0), NVL(C.DBIZ_RANK, 0), A.TE_MNG_MOK_CD, NVL(A.SORT_SEQ, 0), A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID

REPORT_CD , NVL(R.REPORT_DETL_CD, '') AS REPORT_DETL_CD , NVL(R.GOV_SUB, '') AS GOV_SUB , NVL(R.INDI_ATTR, '') AS INDI_ATTR , NVL(R.ADVNC_PROC, '') AS ADVNC_PROC , '' AS REPORT_NAMES , '' AS SHEET_NAMES , NVL(R.SEL010_YN, 'N') AS SEL010_YN , NVL(R.SEL020_YN, 'N') AS SEL020_YN , 'N' AS SEL030_YN , 'N' AS SEL040_YN , 'N' AS SEL050_YN , 'N' AS SEL055_YN , 'N' AS SEL060_YN , 'N' AS SEL090_YN A , TB_DGRDEPT B , TB_DGRBIZ C , TB_YEARFISFG D , TB_DGRTEMNGMOK M , (SELECT Z.FIS_YEAR , Z.BGT_DGR , Z.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD NOT IN ('030','070','0A0','0B0','0C0','0D0') AND NVL(TRIM(Z.REPORT_MSTR),'') != '' THEN Z.REPORT_MSTR ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS REPORT_MSTR , GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN Z.REPORT_CD NOT IN /*BudgetSelectNew.selectReportKeyListFast*/ SELECT E.REPORT_CD AS REPORT_CD , E.REPORT_DETL_CD AS REPORT_DETL_CD , E.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , E.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , E.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AS TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , E.TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ AS TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ FROM TB_REPORT E WHERE E.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND E.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND E.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = #teBgtCompoId#
